name: @wizeworks/email-sequences
description: Reusable multi-touch email journeys (docs/81 §9). A sequence is an ordered list of steps (delay + email); customers are enrolled (by the email.sequence_add action or manually) and a backend drain advances each enrollment on its own clock. Backend-safe like @wizeworks/email-sends (deps: @wizeworks/db + @wizeworks/email-sends only, no render/React) so the automation-worker can run the drain + enroll without dragging in @wizeworks/email/@wizeworks/ui. The client-safe ./schemas subpath (zod only) is what the workbench editor imports.
